scope: Complete pretrained flows, original LoRA and mixed precision, opt-in real-pair RoPE, level-0 PJRT, seeded synthetic inputs. Same stock FP32 CPU forward reference; weights resident, input/output transfers and synchronization included.
finding: The complete shape flow executes at 6.623s for 6181 tokens; occupancy at 4.007s for 4096 tokens. Both are bitwise equal to stock at the FP32 CPU output, and report no fallback.
comparison_note: The retained occupancy baseline is 16.582s with the same checkpoint/seed/shapes, giving a historical ratio of about 4.14x. A fresh paired PJRT stock 6181-token shape run has been launched; the completed 23.96s generated-TTNN baseline uses another SDK/boundary and is not a controlled denominator for the PJRT result.
quality: Single-forward numerical smoke only; no full-trajectory, topology, scene or end-to-end performance acceptance.
